calls.statement:
WITH net_lines AS (
  -- Sales lines: store sales only (store_id < 900), exclude store 999 and test articles
  SELECT 
    f.sale_date,
    f.store_key,
    f.product_key,
    f.net_amount,
    0 AS refund_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Return lines: match to sales store/product/date, return net as negative
  SELECT 
    r.return_date,
    r.store_key,
    r.product_key,
    0 AS net_amount,
    -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
region_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    cs.region,
    SUM(nl.net_amount + nl.refund_net) AS net_sales
  FROM net_lines nl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = nl.sale_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = nl.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  net_sales,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rank
FROM region_sales
ORDER BY rank

-- Check total net sales
SELECT 
  'My query' AS source,
  SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales
FROM (
  WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT 
      f.sale_date,
      f.store_key,
      f.product_key,
      f.net_amount,
      0 AS refund_net
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND s.store_id <> 999
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
      r.return_date,
      r.store_key,
      r.product_key,
      0 AS net_amount,
      -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900
      AND s.store_id <> 999
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  ),
  region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
      cs.region,
      SUM(nl.net_amount + nl.refund_net) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines nl
    INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = nl.sale_date
    INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = nl.store_key
    INNER JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    GROUP BY cs.region
  )
  SELECT net_sales FROM region_sales
) t

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'rpt_daily_store_sales' AS source,
  SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2026-05-04'
  AND business_date <= '2026-10-04'
  AND store_id < 900
  AND store_id <> 999
